panel_findings.statement: In the LixiLan-L pivotal trial data, in patients insufficiently controlled on basal insulin (+ metformin + 1 OAD), the SOLIQUA group had n=366 and an LS mean change in body weight from baseline of -0.7 ± 0.2 kg.
In the LixiLan-L pivotal trial data, the Insulin glargine 100 units/mL group had n=365 and an LS mean change in body weight from baseline of +0.7 ± 0.2 kg.
In the LixiLan-L trial, the difference in LS mean change in body weight between SOLIQUA and Insulin glargine had p<0.0001.
In the SoliMix pivotal trial data, in patients insufficiently controlled on basal insulin + OADs after 26 weeks, the SOLIQUA group had n=443 and an LS mean change in body weight of -0.7 ± 0.2 kg.
In the SoliMix pivotal trial data, the Premix Insulin BIAsp 30 group had n=444 and an LS mean change in body weight of +1.2 ± 0.2 kg.
In the SoliMix trial after 26 weeks, the difference in body weight change between SOLIQUA and Premix Insulin BIAsp 30 had p<0.0001.

In the propensity score matching analysis of LixiLan-L and GGD2, in patients insufficiently controlled on basal insulins, the SOLIQUA group had n=195 and a mean change from baseline in weight of -0.62 ± 0.24 kg.
In the propensity score matching analysis of LixiLan-L and GGD2, the Basal bolus therapy group had n=195 and a mean change from baseline in weight of +0.70 ± 0.24 kg.
In the propensity score matching analysis, the difference in weight change between SOLIQUA and Basal bolus therapy had p<0.0001.
